explanation: Workforce planning matches the work that is coming against the people and skills available to do it, which exposes gaps before they become service failures.
options: The number of office desks against the number of parking spaces
The price of new trucks against the price of used trucks in stock
Forecast workload demand against staff available by skill set
The length of the holiday list against the length of the shift list
optionA: The number of office desks against the number of parking spaces
optionB: The price of new trucks against the price of used trucks in stock
optionC: Forecast workload demand against staff available by skill set
